sections.description: Connects Admetrics Data Studio with your WooCommerce installation.
sections.changelog:
0.7.0

  • Track orders on custom thank-you URLs using a regex matching the path and query string, with configurable order ID and order key parameters.
  • Manage optional custom confirmation settings locally in WooCommerce, independently of Admetrics tracking settings.
  • Require matching order credentials, limit regex processing, and request no caching on matching pages. External page caches and CDNs still require exclusion.

0.6.0

  • Add a scoped tracking-settings connection with administrator approval, secure defaults for new installations, and an opt-in migration for existing legacy connections.
  • Require authorization permanently after approval, including after disconnect; handle concurrent approval/revocation safely.
  • Verify connections asynchronously and show connection/tracking status with collapsed technical details.
  • Encode tracking JSON and attributes safely for quoted configuration and product titles.
  • Standardize installable plugin packages and release metadata.
  • Require WordPress 7.0.7 or later and PHP 8.2 or later; tested with WooCommerce 11.2.1.
  • Track orders on custom confirmation pages that expose WooCommerce's official page filters or confirmation hooks.
  • Defer tracker execution until the document is parsed so confirmation hooks can supply order identity before the first event.
